messages:
Sloane (Growth): Hey team — need a quick creative ask for next week's webinar and the run-up socials. Short timeline: want assets by Tue EOD.
Jamie (Design): ok can you list deliverables + any hard brand rules?
Sloane (Growth): deliverables: 1) a 1‑page infographic that visualizes latency vs cost tradeoffs for our hosted vs dedicated vs private options (callouts for KV cache + batching). 2) 3 social-sized variants (1200x628, 1080x1080, 600x1060) optimized for copy overlays. 3) a two-slide webinar opener template (title + key-findings slide) that PMs can reuse. 4) a small diagram (waterfall) showing request routing & fallback logic.
Alex (Product Marketing): adding requirement: include a compact CTA card for demo scheduling + an optional stat block with: median p50 latency, median p95, cost per 1k tokens estimate for each tier. Keep copy short.
Jamie (Design): got it. Any tone or non-negotiable brand things?
Maria (Brand): Use primary blue (#0A6CF3) and secondary slate (#1F2937). Use Redwood Sans for headings and Inter for body. No gradient backgrounds for benchmark graphics — must be high-contrast accessible. Include our lockup in bottom-left and the legal small-print line: "Performance numbers are representative; results may vary."
Devin (Creative Ops): file formats please: Figma source + exported PNG for socials, PDF one-pager, PPTX starter with editable text. Also need a compressed SVG for the routing diagram.
Sloane (Growth): copy snippets: 
- Headline: "Latency vs Cost: Picking the right inference tier"
- Subhead: "How batching, caching, and model choice change your unit economics"
- CTA: "Book a demo" / short link: redwood.com/demo
- Stat copy sample: "p50 20ms · p95 120ms · $0.12 / 1k tokens"
Jamie (Design): solid — any data source or numbers we should surface?
Alex (Product Marketing): use the numbers from the latest perf deck (see link) — https://redwood.internal/perf/deck/2026-q1 — highlight that numbers are for our reference workloads (token length 256, batch=8).
Maria (Brand): also include small compliance badge for "SOC-ready" in the footer for the webinar opener. Keep badge subtle.
Jamie (Design): timeline check — can do first drafts by Mon morning, final by Tue EOD if no heavy revisions. Is Mon AM draft acceptable?
Sloane (Growth): yes please. Mon AM draft is perfect.
Devin (Creative Ops): looping in distribution: once assets are final, I'll create Handoff JIRA and a short release checklist for comms + paid social specs.
Sloane (Growth): small ask: please make a compact 600px-wide hero image we can drop into the registration landing page.
Jamie (Design): noted. Any preferred photography or illustration?
Maria (Brand): prefer illustration style from our brand kit — abstract nodes + soft shadow. Avoid stock photos for this campaign.
Alex (Product Marketing): one more thing — include a caption variant that calls out "Works with private & on-prem" for privacy-sensitive audience.
Jamie (Design): okay creating 2 variants: general + privacy-first caption.
Sloane (Growth): thanks all. I'll post edits after Mon draft. @Devin please create the JIRA and tag design when drafts are uploaded. :thumbsup:
Devin (Creative Ops): will do — creating JIRA now. JIRA-4453 will track this thread.
Jamie (Design): will upload Figma link to the ticket once draft is ready.
Sloane (Growth): great — appreciate the quick turnaround!
